verdict.rationale: Generating shell commands from natural language is a fair question for a terminal emulator, since competing terminals ship AI command generation, so the axis applies. Nothing in Ghostty's docs, GitHub material or community items describes any AI or natural-language command generation. The documented feature set covers rendering, themes, keybindings, the Quick Terminal and AppleScript, and one user reports leaving Ghostty for Warp because it was too barebones.
